title: Stability Signal Orchestra and Initiative Roll-Forward Rules
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Problem: Multiple SLIs (latency P95/P99, tail error rate, model-serving timeouts, KV-cache hit ratio) are being tracked independently across services and initiatives. That fragmentation makes it hard to decide when to pause, throttle, or roll-forward an initiative when error budgets are at risk. Goal: Create a lightweight orchestration layer (the 'Stability Signal Orchestra') and a decision matrix for initiative roll-forward/rollback that can be consumed by PMs, SREs, and engineers. Deliverables: 1) Decision matrix with thresholds, weightings, and escalation paths for combined signals. 2) A canonical Confluence playbook and a one-page runbook for on-call. 3) Dashboard template and query set for the Console SLI view. 4) An API contract for initiative gating (canary pass/fail evaluation) to be implemented by engineering. Success metrics: - Reduce manual rollback escalations by 50% in the first quarter after launch. - Clear actionable guidance for >90% of initiative leads when their pooled error budget falls into the amber zone. - Dashboard adoption by Product and SRE teams for new initiatives created in Cycle 41. Non-goals: This ticket does not include implementing enforcement automation (that will be a follow-up); initial scope is definition, playbook, and a pilot integration with two teams (Serving Runtime and Dedicated Capacity).
